title: Meridian-Flip and Session Failure Log
dataSources: Observatory environment (`observatory:env`), sky-quality meter (`skyquality:reading`), imaging sessions (`imaging:session`), telescope mount (`mount:status`), cloud sensor (`allsky:cloud`).
app: Backyard observatory automation — roll-off-roof/dome controller, sky-quality meter, cloud sensor, telescope mount, and astrophotography capture software (N.I.N.A./Ekos) — logging to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=imaging:session event=error
| stats count as failures by reason
| sort - failures
description: Groups the errors that ended imaging sessions, from failed meridian flips to lost guide stars, so you can fix the top cause.
value: Automated imaging fails in a handful of predictable ways; naming them turns a ruined night into a concrete reliability fix.
implementation: Ingest session error events into `index=personal`; schedule weekly and rank failure causes.
visualization: Pie chart of session failures by cause.
grandmaExplanation: It sorts the problems that end your automatic night-sky imaging by cause, so you can fix the most common one.
